brief_rationale: The trajectory successfully manages the bounded episode with all 8 responsibility-chain items met and no serious or minor errors. The doctor establishes right-eye laterality, screens for red flags, clarifies medications, creates a practical execution schedule with caregiver-appropriate logging, and obtains clear handoff receipts. Two high-order points are completed: HO1 (co-designed low-burden medication system with fridge chart and family chat) and HO3 (bounded closure with explicit resolved/residual items and teach-back). This meets Strong criteria with two high-order completions for Perfect.
